definitions.full: H1734. Dodo דדי Kt see דּוֺדוֺ below דוד . דּוֺדוֺ proper name, masculine ( his beloved , compare דודוהו ; or compare דודה proper name, of divinity MI 12 , compare דָּוִד infra) — 1 man of tribe of Issachar Judg 10:1 . 2 דדי Kt 2Sam 23:9 ( = דּוֺדַי 1Chr 27:4 ), דּוֺדוֺ Qr = דּוֺדוֺ 11:12 . 3 father of אֶלְחָנָן 2Sam 23:24 דּוֺדוֺ = 1Chr 11:26 .
